html_source: Page from the 15th century Book of O'Lees, an Irish translation of a Latin translation of an Arabic text with Latin words interspersed, held in the Royal Irish Academy, Dublin. Tables containing horizontal, vertical, and diagonal writing list the names, symptoms, cures, etc. of various diseases. Source: www.ria.ie.
